lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh maaiaa mohu hai naam na lago piaar ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is emotionally attached to Maya - he has no love for the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਰੇ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kamaavai kooR sa(n)grahai kooR kare aahaar ||
lines.translation: He practices falsehood, gathers in falsehood, and makes falsehood his sustenance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਭੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikh maaiaa dhan sa(n)ch marahi a(n)te hoi sabh chhaar ||
lines.translation: He collects the poisonous wealth of Maya, and then dies; in the end, it is all reduced to ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam dharam such sa(n)jam karahi a(n)tar lobh vikaar ||
lines.translation: He practices religious rituals, purity and austere self-discipline, but within, there is greed and corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਥਾਇ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak j manamukh kamaavai s thaai naa pavai daragahi hoi khuaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, whatever the self-willed manmukh does, is not acceptable; in the Court of the Lord, he is dishonored. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਖੰਡ ਵਰਭੰਡ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape khaanee aape baanee aape kha(n)d varabha(n)d kare ||
lines.translation: He Himself created the four sources of creation, and He Himself fashioned speech; He Himself formed the worlds and solar systems.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਤਨ ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap samu(n)d aap hai saagar aape hee vich ratan dhare ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the ocean, and He Himself is the sea; He Himself puts the pearls in it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਲਹਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap lahaae kare jis kirapaa jis no guramukh kare hare ||
lines.translation: By His Grace, the Lord enables the Gurmukh to find these pearls.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape bhaujal aap hai bohithaa aape khevat aap tare ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the terrifying world-ocean, and He Himself is the boat; He Himself is the boatman, and He Himself ferries us across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਰੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa avar na doojaa tujhai sare ||9||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself acts, and causes us to act; no one else can equal You, Lord. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee sevaa saphal hai je ko kare chit laai ||
lines.translation: Fruitful is service to the True Guru, if one does so with a sincere mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam padaarath paaeeai achi(n)t vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: The treasure of the Naam, is obtained, and the mind comes to be free of anxiety.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran dukh kateeai haumai mamataa jaai ||
lines.translation: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, and the mind is rid of egotism and self-conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: utam padavee paaeeai sache rahai samaai ||
lines.translation: One achieves the ultimate state, and remains absorbed in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak poorab jin kau likhiaa tinaa satigur miliaa aai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True Guru comes and meets those who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam rataa satiguroo hai kalijug bohith hoi ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is the boat in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai s paar pavai jinaa a(n)dar sachaa soi ||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh crosses over; the True Lord dwells within him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam samhaale naam sa(n)grahai naame hee pat hoi ||
lines.translation: He remembers the Naam, he gathers in the Naam, and he obtains honor through the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur paaiaa karam paraapat hoi ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak has found the True Guru; by His Grace, the Name is obtained. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape paaras aap dhaat hai aap keeton ka(n)chan ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Philosopher's Stone, He Himself is the metal, and He Himself is transformed into gold.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape thaakur sevak aape aape hee paap kha(n)dan ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Lord and Master, He Himself is the servant, and He Himself is the Destroyer of sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਜਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sabh ghat bhogavai suaamee aape hee sabh a(n)jan ||
lines.translation: He Himself enjoys every heart; the Lord Master Himself is the basis of all illusion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਬੇਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੰਜਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap bibek aap sabh betaa aape guramukh bha(n)jan ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the discerning one, and He Himself is the Knower of all; He Himself breaks the bonds of the Gurmukhs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਨ ਰਜੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਵਡਨੁ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak saalaahi na rajai tudh karate too har sukhadaataa vadan ||10||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is not satisfied by merely praising You, O Creator Lord; You are the Great Giver of peace. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur seve jee ke ba(n)dhanaa jete karam kamaahi ||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, the deeds which are done are only chains binding the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਠਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur seve thavar na paavahee mar ja(n)mahi aavahi jaahi ||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, they find no place of rest. They die, only to be born again - they continue coming and going.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur seve phikaa bolanaa naam na vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, their speech is insipid. They do not enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bin satigur seve jam pur badhe maareeahi muhi kaalai uth jaahi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, they are bound and gagged, and beaten in the City of Death; they depart with blackened faces. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik satigur kee sevaa karahi chaakaree har naame lagai piaar ||
lines.translation: Some wait upon and serve the True Guru; they embrace love for the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੁਲ ਕਾ ਕਰਨਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak janam savaaran aapanaa kul kaa karan udhaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they reform their lives, and redeem their generations as well. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਚਾਟਸਾਲ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਾਧਾ ਆਪੇ ਚਾਟੜੇ ਪੜਣ ਕਉ ਆਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape chaatasaal aap hai paadhaa aape chaataRe paRan kau aane ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the school, He Himself is the teacher, and He Himself brings the students to be taught.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਆਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape pitaa maataa hai aape aape baalak kare siaane ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the father, He Himself is the mother, and He Himself makes the children wise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਥੈ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਇਕ ਥੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਇਆਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik thai paR bujhai sabh aape ik thai aape kare iaane ||
lines.translation: In one place, He teaches them to read and understand everything, while in another place, He Himself makes them ignorant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa a(n)dar mahal bulaae jaa aap terai man sache bhaane ||
lines.translation: Some, You summon to the Mansion of Your Presence within, when they are pleasing to Your Mind, O True Lord.
